description: LiNa₅Mo₉O₃₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.63 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-61°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.60 Å. Li is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-67°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.35 Å. There are five inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.51 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.60 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.51 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.31 Å. In the fifth Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one LiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-57°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.23 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Mo atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li and two Mo atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Li, and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Mo atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one Mo atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom.
